snippet.title: Shanwen - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
1990s: Windswept mining town Linshan, dependent on fading coal mines, worshipped a mountain god’s stele. After it cracked and oozed brown liquid, a strange illness spread. Lin Tianqing returned for his sick father, uneasy as the eerie town neared, having overheard whispers. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4327330/Shanwen/

Developer: FirstMove Studio
